name: respire
description: respire memory for Kimi Code: every-round title-tier recall, one-prefix store, model-optional degradation. On-machine registration via rsrs register for sync; the sidecar model is an optional boost.
author: risense-ai

interface.shortDescription: 吸即存，呼即取 — Kimi Code 的本地加密记忆层
interface.longDescription: respire（CLI：rsrs）为 Kimi Code 提供本地优先、端侧加密的记忆层：每轮自动注入标题档召回，「记：」前缀即刻落库，Stop 钩子提醒存储新事实与教训。数据本地加密存储，本机 rsrs register 注册即享云端 LWW 同步；可选的 BGE-M3 语义增强，未装时自动回退词面档，开箱即用。
